content: No dedicated github discussion found showing multi-event dots/chips patterns built on react-day-picker's DayButton in v10; official guidance only covers composing around the default DayButton while preserving accessibility/keyboard behavior. react-day-picker's stated purpose is a date PICKER (single date or range selection input), not an events/agenda calendar -- confirms it is the wrong abstraction to stretch into a 3-chip+overflow multi-event month view.
